data.one_liner: String truncation library supporting predefined and custom truncation strategies.
data.what_it_does: Provides functions to truncate strings using different positions such as start, end, or middle. It supports custom omission strings and custom truncation strategies.
use_when: You need to shorten long strings to a specific character limit
You need to place truncation indicators at the start, middle, or end of a string
avoid_when: You need advanced text layout measurements or multi-line wrapping handled by widgets
strengths: Allows custom truncation strategies and omission strings
weaknesses: Very limited scope dealing only with basic string truncation
